story.story:
Before dawn, a quiet neighbourhood street rests beneath a blue sky. One shop is already glowing. Through its front window, a baker in a flour-dusted apron sets a ball of dough on a wooden workbench.

Inside, the baker folds the dough, presses it forward with both palms, and shapes a loaf. Beside the flour bowl, a tray of plump, ready-to-bake croissants waits. The baker slides the loaf and pastry tray into the oven.

Time passes as the window brightens. The oven door opens, releasing a cloud of steam. Wearing thick mitts, the baker draws out golden loaves and deeply browned croissants. A crust crackles as the bread settles onto a wire cooling rack.

The baker turns the sign on the blue front door to OPEN. A neighbour carrying a canvas shopping bag steps inside, followed by a parent holding a child’s hand. The child spots the croissants and smiles.

At the counter, the baker slips a croissant into a paper bag and hands it to the neighbour. The parent receives a warm loaf wrapped in paper. The baker’s tired face brightens at their grateful smiles.

Outside, sunlight reaches the shop sign: “The Corner Oven.” Beneath the name, the final words appear: “Come in. Your morning starts here.”

asset_specs.name: baker
asset_specs.height: An average-height grown man with a broad, sturdy build.
asset_specs.spec: A middle-aged man with warm tan skin, a broad face, brown eyes, a short brown moustache, and short, slightly wavy dark-brown hair. He wears a cream shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbows, midnight-blue trousers, dark-brown work shoes, and a honey-tan bib apron tied at the waist. Irregular flour-white dustings mark the apron’s chest and front, and faint lines beneath his eyes give him a gently tired appearance.

asset_specs.name: flour dusting the apron
asset_specs.height: A small dusting of powder, much less than a handful.
asset_specs.spec: Fine, flour-white powder forming irregular, thin patches and scattered tiny specks. Its edges are soft and uneven, with a few denser chalky spots rather than distinct lumps.

asset_specs.name: ball of dough
asset_specs.height: About the size of a small melon; comfortably cupped in two adult hands.
asset_specs.spec: A plump, roughly spherical ball of pale cream dough with a slightly flattened base. Its soft surface is mostly smooth, with a shallow folded seam and a faint powdery coating; it has no scoring or browned crust.

asset_specs.name: loaf
asset_specs.height: About one sixth of a grown person’s height in length; supported in two hands.
asset_specs.spec: A broad, oval loaf with rounded ends, a honey-gold crust, and three diagonal expansion marks across its domed top. The crust has a fine, slightly uneven texture and a darker toasted-brown lower edge. Plain cream wrapping paper cups its base and lower sides in overlapping folds, leaving the scored top exposed.

asset_specs.name: pastry tray
asset_specs.height: About one quarter of a grown person’s height across; carried with two hands.
asset_specs.spec: A shallow rectangular tray of dull charcoal-grey metal, with rounded corners and a narrow raised rim on all four sides. It holds six plump, unbaked butter-yellow croissants, each with a thick rolled centre, visible overlapping bands, and tapered inward-curving tips. The tray has no handles, decoration, or lettering.

asset_specs.name: croissants
asset_specs.height: Six palm-sized pastries; each fits in one adult hand.
asset_specs.spec: A group of six plump, unbaked croissants made from pale butter-yellow dough. Each forms a broad crescent with a thick middle, three clearly overlapping rolled bands, and two tapered tips curling inward. Their surfaces are smooth and soft, without a browned crust.

asset_specs.name: baker's thick mitts
asset_specs.height: A matched pair, each large enough to enclose one adult hand and wrist.
asset_specs.spec: Two thick oven mitts made from cream quilted cotton, each with a rounded finger pocket and a separate broad thumb. Honey-ochre binding outlines the cuffs, and the quilting forms a regular diamond pattern. They are clean, padded, and undecorated.

asset_specs.name: neighbour
asset_specs.height: A grown woman, slightly shorter than the baker.
asset_specs.spec: An older woman with a compact build, peach-toned skin, a round face, brown eyes, and a chin-length silver-grey bob tucked neatly behind her ears. She wears a soft-blue cardigan over a cream blouse, a calf-length terracotta skirt, and plain dark-brown shoes. Small round brown-framed glasses and gently creased cheeks are her fixed distinguishing features.

asset_specs.name: canvas shopping bag
asset_specs.height: About one fifth of a grown person’s height, with handles long enough for one-handed carrying.
asset_specs.spec: A plain rectangular shopping bag made from sturdy natural-cream canvas, with a flat base and lightly gusseted sides. Two broad honey-tan fabric handles rise from its top edge. It has visible stitched seams but no pockets, printing, or decoration.

asset_specs.name: parent
asset_specs.height: An average-height grown woman with a lean build.
asset_specs.spec: A young adult woman with medium-brown skin, an oval face, dark-brown eyes, and dark-brown curly hair gathered into a low bun. She wears a terracotta hip-length jacket over a butter-yellow shirt, deep-blue straight trousers, and brown ankle boots. A few short curls frame her forehead, and her clothes have no patterns or logos.

asset_specs.name: child
asset_specs.height: A small child, about half the height of a grown person.
asset_specs.spec: A child of about five with medium-brown skin, a round face, large dark-brown eyes, and short, springy dark-brown curls. The child wears a sky-blue jumper over a cream shirt, honey-ochre trousers, and small dark-brown shoes. The build is small and softly rounded, with full cheeks and a button nose.

asset_specs.name: croissant handed to the neighbour
asset_specs.height: Palm-sized; fits comfortably in one adult hand.
asset_specs.spec: A plump crescent-shaped croissant with a honey-gold crust, a thick rolled centre, and two tapered tips curling inward. Three overlapping bands cross its body, with fine flaky ridges and toasted-brown edges. It has no filling, icing, or topping.

asset_specs.name: paper bag
asset_specs.height: About the length of an adult hand, with room for one palm-sized pastry.
asset_specs.spec: A small upright bag made from plain honey-brown kraft paper, with a rectangular base, folded side gussets, and an open, unsealed top. It contains one plump honey-gold croissant, with its curved upper ridge visible above the opening. The bag has no handles, printing, or decorative marks.

asset_specs.name: paper wrapping the loaf
asset_specs.height: A sheet large enough to cradle a two-hand-sized loaf; manageable in two adult hands.
asset_specs.spec: A broad rectangular sheet of plain cream food-wrapping paper with a thin, flexible body and straight-cut edges. It has loose lengthwise creases and overlapping corner folds that form a shallow open cradle. There is no printing, ribbon, label, or coloured border.

doors.swing: Hinged on its left edge as seen here; opens inward toward the camera and rests flat against the left wall. Reserve the entire leaf sweep and keep the resting leaf clear of the counter and entry route.
Hinged along its bottom edge; lowers toward the centre of the room to a horizontal stop. Its projection stays within the reserved oven working space, leaving a clear passage beside it.

marks.name: Blue shop front door
marks.essential: Blue glazed door at the far left.
marks.size: A little taller than a grown person and comfortably wide for one adult.
marks.faces: Closed inner face toward the camera; opens toward the camera.
marks.where: Far left in the front wall, with its left hinge jamb against the left side wall. Blue-painted timber surrounds a clear upper pane and a solid lower panel; a narrow brick pier separates its right edge from the window.

marks.name: Interior door handle
marks.essential: On the door's right free edge.
marks.size: Hand-sized, at adult waist height.
marks.where: Far left, on the right edge of the blue door, below its glazing and clear of the sign.

marks.name: Door-mounted shop name sign
marks.essential: Far left at adult chest height.
marks.size: Slightly wider than adult shoulders and about a forearm high.
marks.faces: Inner face toward the camera; matching outer face toward the street.
marks.where: Far left, fixed within the blue door's clear upper pane. The two-faced cream nameplate reads “The Corner Oven”, with “Come in. Your morning starts here.” beneath it; its captive status strip can be turned from this side.

marks.name: Reversible OPEN and CLOSED strip
marks.essential: Captive turning strip along the sign's bottom edge.
marks.size: About two hands wide and one hand high.
marks.faces: Initially OPEN toward the camera and CLOSED toward the street; rotates vertically.
marks.where: Far left, within the bottom edge of shop-sign, mounted on a central vertical pivot with finger clearance around both ends.

marks.name: Shop front window
marks.essential: Large clear window in the far-right front wall.
marks.size: About one grown person lying down wide; sill hip-high and top above adult head height.
marks.faces: Inner face toward the camera; looks outward to the street.
marks.where: Far right in the front wall. Its single broad pane, cream-painted timber frame, and hip-high sill match the street view; the narrow brick pier is at its left edge.

marks.name: Wooden workbench
marks.essential: Far right, with its working edge toward the camera.
marks.size: Waist-high, as long as a grown person lying down, and about half an arm-span deep.
marks.faces: Long axis left to right; working side toward the camera.
marks.where: Far right, beneath the front window with a small gap behind it. Its right end approaches the right wall; its centre and left end remain clear for preparation.

marks.name: Workbench working surface
marks.essential: Flat upper surface at waist height.
marks.size: As long as a grown person lying down.
marks.where: Far right, forming the top of workbench. The central preparation surface and the left-hand tray space are both empty.

marks.name: Workbench standing space
marks.essential: Open floor along the workbench's near edge.
marks.size: Deep enough for an adult to stand, lean, and turn.
marks.where: Far right, immediately on the camera side of workbench; opens directly into work-aisle without steps or obstructions.

marks.name: Flour bowl
marks.essential: At the far-right end of the worktop.
marks.size: An adult forearm across and a hand deep.
marks.where: Far right, seated securely on the right end of workbench.top, close to the right wall. The empty worktop immediately to its left can accommodate a pastry tray.

marks.name: Baking oven
marks.essential: Middle right against the right wall.
marks.size: Chest-high and about two adult shoulder-widths wide.
marks.where: Middle right against the right wall, nearer the camera than workbench. Its front stands well back from the counter, leaving a broad working aisle.

marks.name: Drop-down oven door
marks.essential: Bottom-hinged door on the oven's centre-facing front.
marks.size: Two shoulder-widths wide; projects about a forearm when lowered.
marks.faces: Opens downward and toward the centre-left.
marks.where: Middle right on the oven front, initially closed. Its horizontal handle is below waist height; the lowered leaf occupies only the right-hand portion of work-aisle.

marks.name: Oven baking chamber
marks.essential: Waist-level chamber behind the oven's front door.
marks.size: Wide enough for a loaf and pastry tray together.
marks.where: Middle right within oven, supported above its solid base. Fixed internal runners provide a level loading surface reachable from the clear aisle.

marks.name: Wire cooling rack
marks.essential: Near right against the right wall.
marks.size: Waist-high, two shoulder-widths long, and a forearm deep.
marks.where: Near right against the right wall, nearer the camera than oven, with a clear gap between them. A rigid metal stand supports its empty wire surface.

marks.name: Cooling surface
marks.essential: Upper wire surface at waist height.
marks.size: Large enough for a loaf and several croissants.
marks.where: Near right, spanning the top of cooling-rack with no objects on it.

marks.name: Shop counter
marks.essential: Middle left, running from near to far.
marks.size: Waist-high, as long as a grown person lying down, and a forearm deep.
marks.faces: Customer side left; working side right.
marks.where: Middle left, parallel to the right wall. Its far end stops well short of the front wall and door swing; its near end stops before the camera position. Broad open passages remain on both long sides.

marks.name: Counter service surface
marks.essential: Clear upper surface at waist height.
marks.size: Long enough for two side-by-side service positions.
marks.where: Middle left, forming the top of counter. The entire surface is empty and visible across its left and right edges.

marks.name: Customer standing side
marks.essential: Open floor along the counter's left side.
marks.size: Wide enough for two adults to pass; long enough for a small queue.
marks.where: Middle left between counter and the left wall, continuing toward the near-left foreground. Connects directly to entry without crossing the working side.

marks.name: Counter working side
marks.essential: Open floor along the counter's right side.
marks.size: Wide enough to stand, turn, and reach across the counter.
marks.where: Middle centre immediately right of counter, forming the left-hand margin of work-aisle. Nothing is stored beneath or across this standing space.

marks.name: Entrance and arrival space
marks.essential: Clear floor at the far left.
marks.size: Room for three people beyond the full door swing.
marks.where: Far left inside shop-front-door, extending rightward and toward the camera beyond the leaf sweep. Leads around the counter's far end into counter.customer-side.

marks.name: Preparation and baking aisle
marks.essential: Broad clear passage through the centre-right.
marks.size: At least an adult arm-span wide, with passage remaining beside the lowered oven door.
marks.faces: Runs from far right toward near right.
marks.where: Centre-right between counter and the right-wall equipment. Joins the workbench standing space, oven front, cooling rack, and counter working side; reserve extra turning space before the oven.

scene-3-clip-1.prompt: Image 1 is the first frame and image 2 the last frame of one continuous shot; the camera does not move. Baker pulls the oven door down toward us as steam rolls out of the opening. pulls down the oven door; grip the lowered oven door's handle. Natural motion only; nothing appears that is not in the frames. Sound: Low oven hum and faint birdsong outside.; creak and click of the oven door opening, brief hiss of escaping steam; no voices; no music.

scene-3-clip-2.prompt: Image 1 is the first frame and image 2 the last frame of one continuous shot; the camera does not move. Baker draws a golden loaf and a tray of deeply browned croissants out of the oven with thick mitts. holds the loaf and croissant tray clear of the oven; support the loaf and pastry tray. Natural motion only; nothing appears that is not in the frames. Sound: Low oven hum and faint birdsong outside.; metal tray scraping out along oven rails; no voices; no music.

scene-3-clip-3.prompt: Image 1 is the first frame and image 2 the last frame of one continuous shot; the camera does not move. Baker sets the croissant tray on the wooden workbench while keeping the loaf in one mitt. sets the tray on the workbench at the far right; release the tray while supporting the loaf; rests on the workbench's working surface; rest on the tray on the workbench; remains supported beside the workbench. Natural motion only; nothing appears that is not in the frames. Sound: Low oven hum and faint birdsong outside.; light clatter of the tray on the wooden workbench; no voices; no music.

scene-3-clip-4.prompt: Image 1 is the first frame and image 2 the last frame of one continuous shot; the camera does not move. Sound: Low oven hum and faint birdsong outside.; soft tap and faint wire rattle as the loaf meets the rack, delicate snaps and crackles from the cooling crust; no voices; no music.
